sources.snippet: ppo-Pyramids is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find ppo-Pyramids on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of ppo-Pyramids install, users can directly use ppo-Pyramids installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.

sources.snippet: Unity ML-Agents PPO 强化学习 智能体（Pyramids 环境）模型在华为昇腾 NPU 上的推理适配。 本项目为 非 LLM 强化学习模型，不使用 vLLM-Ascend，直接以 torch_npu 完成图内推理，精度与官方权重一致。
